instruction: A fitness studio photograph of two women exercising. In a bright white studio, the wavy-haired woman (R10) in the foreground and the light brown-haired woman (R5) in the background perform synchronized forward lunges. Both wear matching black sports bras and black athletic leggings with white sneakers. They align diagonally, each placing their hands on their front knee for balance while looking forward with focused expressions. Both women maintain a strong, athletic posture. The scene is illuminated by bright, clean studio lighting that creates a minimalist aesthetic against the seamless white background.
